description: This file defines the PageSettings class responsible for parsing and applying page setup configurations from XML to a Spreadsheet in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: PageSettings
classes.description: A class responsible for extracting page setup details from an XML element and applying these settings to a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PageSettings object by parsing the provided XML for page setup configurations and print settings.

methods.name: loadPageSettings
methods.description: Applies the parsed page settings to the active sheet of the given Spreadsheet.

methods.name: pageSetup
methods.description: Extracts page setup configurations from XML and updates printDefaults accordingly.

methods.name: printSetup
methods.description: Extracts print-specific settings from XML into printDefaults.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets layout options such as orientation and centered margins based on XML attributes.

methods.name: setMargins
methods.description: Sets page margin values based on XML attributes.

search-terms: PHP class for XML page configuration
